title: Functorial K-injective replacement
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] and $\mathsf{Cpx}(\mathcal A)$ its category of cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There is a functor $I:\mathsf{Cpx}(\mathcal A)\to\mathsf{Cpx}(\mathcal A)$ and a natural transformation $\eta:\mathrm{id}\Rightarrow I$ such that, for every complex $K$, $\eta_K:K\to I(K)$ is a quasi-isomorphism [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and $I(K)$ is K-injective (for every acyclic complex $A$ the complex $\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(A,I(K))$ is acyclic, as in [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions] with $\mathcal A$ in place of $\Mod(T_{\Et},R)$).
